title: Order of the Sinking Star outsells The Witness 🧩
subject: orderofthesinkingstar
description:
Have you tried Order of the Sinking Star? 👇

Jonathan Blow says Order of the Sinking Star sold 45% more units on Steam in its first week than The Witness, with a 33% higher peak player count. The puzzle game from Thekla launched October 8, 2026 at $29.99, below The Witness' $39.99 launch price.

Sources: Jonathan Blow on X, Order of the Sinking Star Steam announcement, Gamer Headlines, se7en.ws (Oct 18, 2026), Wikipedia

scenes.text: Jonathan Blow's new puzzle game is outselling The Witness.
Order of the Sinking Star came out October 8. Blow says its first week on Steam moved 45 percent more copies than The Witness did in 2016.
The Steam player peak was 33 percent higher too.
